content_sections.heading: LBSNAA Multi-Tasking Staff (Group 'C') Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.lal_bahadur_shastri_national_academy_of_: Matriculation from a recognised Board or equivalent (relaxable in exceptional circumstances as per DoPT OM No. 14014/1/2022-Estt.(D) dated 02.08.2022)

content_sections.heading: LBSNAA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. A-12012/1/202026-ADM gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download LBSNAA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Matriculation from a recognised Board or equivalent; Educational qualification is relaxable in exceptional circumstances in accordance with DoPT OM No. 14014/1/2022-Estt. (D) dated 2nd August, 2022; Only a dependent family member of a Government servant of LBSNAA who died in harness or retired on medical grounds up to 31st October, 2026 Age limit: Between 18 & 25 years Age relaxation: Upper age limit Could be relaxed wherever found to be necessary Other conditions: Open only to one dependent family member of a Government servant who died in harness or retired on medical grounds up to 31st October, 2026 Appointment is under the compassionate ground quota of LBSNAA

rows.event: Cut-off for death in harness / retirement on medical grounds of the Government servant
Last Date for Submission of Application (by 5.30 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will LBSNAA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification of applications for fulfilment of eligibility conditions Assessment on a 100-point scale (Relative Merit Points System) as per Annexure-I of the Academy policy notified vide office order no. 298 dated 27.10.2026 Applications are assessed on a 100-point scale with parameters in Annexure-I of office order no. 298 dated 27.10.2026 Ambiguous, incomplete or unsupported information gets zero marks for that parameter Ties are decided as per para (5) of DoPT OM No. A-12012/1/2021-Ad.IV (Cadre) dated 7th April, 2022 Family pension checked as on month preceding application; income for Financial Year 2025-26; property as on date of application

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format Notarised affidavit on Rs. 100/- stamp paper regarding consent of other dependents Notarised affidavit on Rs. 100/- stamp paper declaring movable/immovable property and monthly present income from employment Self-attested death certificate of the Government servant and spouse (if applicable), or medical retirement documents/disability certificate Proof of relationship; self-attested educational certificates and Date of Birth Certificate Income certificate from Competent Revenue Authority/Tahsildar and property details with proof of market value

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LBSNAA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format from the Academy website or obtain it from the Establishment Section, LBSNAA, Mussoorie. Fill in and sign the application form. Attach the enclosures and supporting documents listed in para 11 of the notice. Submit to the Establishment Section, LBSNAA, Mussoorie by registered post or in person through CRU Section. Ensure submission by 5.30 PM on or before 08.12.2026 (Tuesday).

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who applied under earlier notifications must submit a fresh application under the new policy False information in an affidavit may lead to rejection, cancellation of the offer or termination of services Late applications are liable to be cancelled Facilitation committee: B.N. Dabral 9997743859, Jata Shankar 8171898299, Shailendra Rawat 9169025814; email [email protected] ; phone 0135-222295

content_sections.heading: LBSNAA Multi-Tasking Staff (Group 'C') Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for LBSNAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in LBSNAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for Multi-Tasking Staff (Group 'C').

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for LBSNAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format (Annexure-II) can be downloaded from the Academy website or obtained from the Establishment Section, LBSNAA, Mussoorie) and send it to Establishment Section, LBSNAA, Mussoorie, by registered post or in person through cru section, to reach by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 & 25 years. Relaxation: Upper age limit Could be relaxed wherever found to be necessary.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Matriculation from a recognised Board or equivalent (relaxable in exceptional circumstances as per DoPT OM No. 14014/1/2022-Estt.(D) dated 02.08.2022).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to one dependent family member of a Government servant who died in harness or retired on medical grounds up to 31st October, 2026. Appointment is under the compassionate ground quota of LBSNAA.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Verification of applications for fulfilment of eligibility conditions. Assessment on a 100-point scale (Relative Merit Points System) as per Annexure-I of the Academy policy notified vide office order no. 298 dated 27.10.2026. Applications are assessed on a 100-point scale with parameters in Annexure-I of office order no. 298 dated 27.10.2026. Ambiguous, incomplete or unsupported information gets zero marks for that parameter.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: LBSNAA, Mussoorie.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format; Notarised affidavit on Rs. 100/- stamp paper regarding consent of other dependents; Notarised affidavit on Rs. 100/- stamp paper declaring movable/immovable property and monthly present income from employment; Self-attested death certificate of the Government servant and spouse (if applicable), or medical retirement documents/disability certificate; Proof of relationship; self-attested educational certificates and Date of Birth Certificate; Income certificate from Competent Revenue Authority/Tahsildar and property details with proof of market value.

faq.question: Q10. I applied under the earlier advertisement. What should I do?
faq.answer: Candidates who applied under earlier notifications must submit a fresh application under the new policy.
